classes.objetivo: Reconocer frases que permiten a otra persona salvar la cara tras un error o un comentario brusco, y expresar lamentos propios con wish e if only.

vocabulario.es: salvar las apariencias, no quedar en ridículo

ensenanza.en: It's easily done; I once sent a private message to the whole team, so this is only an honest mistake.
ensenanza.es: Es fácil que pase; una vez envié un mensaje privado a todo el equipo, así que esto es solo un error sin mala intención.
ensenanza.nota: It's easily done quita peso al error: lo presenta como algo que le pasa a cualquiera, incluido el hablante.

ensenanza.en: I may not have been clear about the deadline, so I am happy to take the blame for the confusion.
ensenanza.es: Puede que yo no haya sido claro con el plazo, así que acepto con gusto la culpa de la confusión.
ensenanza.nota: I may not have been clear reparte la culpa; take the blame = asumirla de forma voluntaria.

ensenanza.en: No real harm was done, so I will let you off the hook and we can avoid an awkward conversation.
ensenanza.es: No hubo ningún daño real, así que te libero de la culpa y podemos evitar una conversación incómoda.
ensenanza.nota: No real harm resta importancia a las consecuencias; off the hook = libre de responsabilidad.

ensenanza.en: I should warn you that the remark sounded sharp, but I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.
ensenanza.es: Debo avisarte de que el comentario sonó áspero, pero te daré el beneficio de la duda.
ensenanza.nota: El beneficio de la duda supone buena intención; I should warn you suaviza el aviso antes de la crítica.

ensenanza.en: In hindsight, I wish I had made the change clear in person; I hope there are no hard feelings.
ensenanza.es: Visto ahora, ojalá hubiera dejado clara la modificación en persona; espero que no haya rencores.
ensenanza.nota: Wish + had + participio lamenta algo pasado; in hindsight y no hard feelings suavizan el tono.

ensenanza.en: If only I had been clearer, the talk would not have been so awkward, and I could have helped you save face.
ensenanza.es: Si hubiera sido más claro, la charla no habría sido tan incómoda y te habría ayudado a salvar las apariencias.
ensenanza.nota: If only + had + participio expresa un lamento sobre el pasado; save face = evitar que el otro quede mal.

explicacion.texto: Salvar la cara (save face) es darle a otra persona una salida digna tras un error o un comentario brusco. En inglés se consigue quitando peso al error (It's easily done, No real harm done), asumiendo parte del problema (I may not have been clear, I'll take the blame) o suponiendo buena intención (I'm sure you didn't mean it that way; I'll give you the benefit of the doubt). Para lamentar algo propio del pasado usa wish / if only + had + participio: I wish I had explained it better. Nunca empieces por you always / you never.

patron.texto: Quitar peso + asumir parte + suponer buena intención:

formula.nota: quitas peso al error: le puede pasar a cualquiera

formula.texto: I may not have been clear.
I'm sure you didn't mean it that way.
I wish I had explained it better.

filas.texto: I may not have been clear.
I'm sure you didn't mean it that way.
I wish I had explained it better.

erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Done es un participio y lo modifica un adverbio: easily, no el adjetivo easy.

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: I wish I explained it better.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: I wish I had explained it better.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Para lamentar algo pasado el inglés exige had + participio; el español usa el pretérito y por eso se cuela explained.

situacion.contexto: Mia olvidó enviar una lista y Tom intenta que no se sienta mal.

dialogo.texto: Tom, I forgot to send the list to everyone. I feel bad.
dialogo.traduccion: Tom, olvidé enviar la lista a todos. Me siento mal.

dialogo.texto: It's easily done. No harm done; the meeting is tomorrow.
dialogo.traduccion: Es fácil que pase. No ha pasado nada; la reunión es mañana.

dialogo.texto: I wish I had checked it twice.
dialogo.traduccion: Ojalá lo hubiera revisado dos veces.

dialogo.texto: And I may not have been clear about the deadline. Let's move on.
dialogo.traduccion: Y puede que yo no fuera claro con el plazo. Sigamos adelante.

item.consigna: Según el diálogo, ¿cómo ayuda Tom a que Mia no se sienta mal?

opciones.es: Le quita peso al olvido y asume parte de la culpa.
Le pide que envíe la lista otra vez hoy.
Le dice que la reunión ya ha empezado.

item.feedback: Tom dice «It's easily done» y «I may not have been clear about the deadline»: normaliza el error y comparte la culpa.

guiada.consigna: Elige la frase de Sara que permite a Leo salvar la cara.
opciones: It's easily done; I nearly did the very same thing myself only last week.
You should have checked the attachment before you pressed send.
No harm done this time, but I will be checking everything you send from now on.
guiada.texto: Leo sent the client last year's price list by mistake and now sits red-faced at his desk. Sara, who saw the email go out, leans over and says something kind.
guiada.feedback: Sara quita peso al error y se incluye a sí misma; las otras frases culpan a Leo con un reproche o con una amenaza disfrazada de consuelo.
guiada.pista: Busca la frase que normaliza el error sin acusar.

guiada.consigna: Completa: «No te preocupes: fue un error sin mala intención y no pasó nada grave.»
guiada.texto: Don't worry about the late report. It was an honest ___, and no real harm was done.
guiada.feedback: An honest mistake presenta el fallo como involuntario; eso ayuda al otro a salvar la cara.
guiada.pista: Sustantivo: un fallo involuntario; empieza por m.

guiada.consigna: Ordena: «Puede que yo no haya sido claro con la hora.»
guiada.respuesta: I may not have been clear about the time
guiada.feedback: I may not have been clear reparte la culpa: el hablante asume parte del malentendido.
guiada.pista: Empieza por I may not have been y termina con about the time.

practica.consigna: Escucha y elige cómo ayuda la hablante a su compañera Mia.
practica.audio: Mia forgot to book the room, and the whole team arrived to find the door locked. I could have been angry, but I said it was easily done, that I had not reminded her, and that I would speak to the manager myself. She looked so relieved that we laughed about it over coffee.
opciones: She makes light of the mistake and shares responsibility for it.
She hides the mistake from the manager in order to protect Mia.
She tells Mia off gently but promises to forgive her.
She insists that Mia explain herself to the manager.
practica.feedback: La hablante quita peso («easily done») y reparte la culpa («I had not reminded her»); no esconde nada ni regaña.

practica.consigna: Relaciona cada frase con el efecto que tiene sobre quien cometió el error.
pares: It's easily done; it could happen to anyone
Normaliza el error
I may not have been clear about the start time
Reparte la culpa
I'm sure you didn't mean it that way
Supone buena intención
No real harm done; we still have a week
Resta importancia a las consecuencias
I wish I had checked the room myself
Lamenta algo propio sin dramatizar
practica.feedback: Cada frase salva la cara de una manera: normaliza, reparte la culpa, supone buena intención, resta gravedad o lamenta algo propio.

practica.consigna: ¿Qué efecto busca la autora con su respuesta a Tom?
opciones: To reassure Tom and stop him feeling upset about the error.
To warn Tom that future errors will not be accepted.
To blame herself entirely and ask Tom to forgive her.
To point out that Tom should have checked the date twice.
practica.texto: Dear Tom, thank you for telling me straight away that you sent the invitation with the wrong date. It is easily done, and I suspect my original note was not clear either. I have corrected it, so no real harm has been done, and please do not apologise again.
practica.feedback: Usa «easily done», comparte la culpa y resta importancia: tranquiliza a Tom, no le advierte, no se culpa por completo ni le reprocha.

evaluacion.consigna: Escucha el relato y elige qué recurso usa Carlos para que Sara no pierda la cara.
evaluacion.audio: Sara had promised to send the rent to the landlord by Friday, but on Monday she realised that she had used the wrong account number. She told Carlos, expecting him to be furious. Instead, he said it was easily done and added that he might not have been clear when he wrote the number on the fridge. He reminded her that the landlord had never charged a late fee, so no real harm was likely. Then he asked whether she wanted to ring the bank together. Sara said later that she felt lighter, although she still wished she had checked the number twice.
opciones: He plays down the error and shares part of the responsibility.
He takes the whole blame himself and apologises to the landlord.
He reminds her that the rent is late and must be paid today.
He warns her gently that the mistake could be very costly.
evaluacion.feedback: Carlos dice que es fácil que pase y que puede que él no fuera claro: quita peso y reparte la culpa, sin asumirla por entero ni advertir de costes.

evaluacion.consigna: Escucha de nuevo: ¿qué sugiere el final del relato sobre cómo se siente Sara?
evaluacion.audio: Sara had promised to send the rent to the landlord by Friday, but on Monday she realised that she had used the wrong account number. She told Carlos, expecting him to be furious. Instead, he said it was easily done and added that he might not have been clear when he wrote the number on the fridge. He reminded her that the landlord had never charged a late fee, so no real harm was likely. Then he asked whether she wanted to ring the bank together. Sara said later that she felt lighter, although she still wished she had checked the number twice.
opciones: Relieved, although she still regrets her own mistake.
Completely calm, since the matter is now closed.
Guilty, because Carlos ended up accepting most of the blame himself.
Worried, because the landlord may still refuse the payment.
evaluacion.feedback: Se siente más ligera, pero sigue deseando haber revisado el número: alivio con un resto de lamento propio.

evaluacion.consigna: Completa: «Estoy dispuesta a darle el beneficio de la duda.»
evaluacion.texto: Leo's comment about the presentation sounded rude. He was tired, though, and he has never been unkind before, so I am willing to give him the benefit of the ___.
evaluacion.feedback: The benefit of the doubt es la fórmula fija para suponer buena intención sin tener pruebas.

evaluacion.consigna: Ayuda a Tom a salvar la cara: resta importancia y asume parte de la culpa.
evaluacion.texto: Tom envió al cliente la factura equivocada. Dile que es fácil que pase y que quizá tú tampoco fuiste claro con el código de la factura.
evaluacion.respuesta: It's easily done, Tom, and no real harm has been done; I may not have been clear about the invoice code.
aceptadas: It could happen to anyone, Tom. I might not have been clear about the code on the invoice, so let's fix it together.

evidencias: i may not have been clear
i might not have been clear
i may not have made it clear

evaluacion.feedback: La respuesta combina dos recursos: normaliza el error (It's easily done) y reparte la culpa (I may not have been clear).

repaso.consigna: ¿Qué valora más la autora en este mensaje a Mia?
opciones: That Mia was honest about her slip instead of hiding it.
That Mia had already fixed the notes before anyone noticed the gap.
That the new checklist will prevent every future error.
That she was right to remind Mia on Friday.
repaso.texto: Hi Mia, thanks for telling me about the missing notes. I'm sure you didn't mean to leave them out, and honestly, I should have reminded you on Friday. In hindsight, the plan was vague, so let's agree on a checklist and move on. No hard feelings at all; I would rather have a colleague who admits a slip than one who hides it.
repaso.feedback: La autora dice preferir a una colega que admite un fallo antes que a una que lo oculta: valora la honestidad, no el control ni su propio aviso.

repaso.consigna: Ordena: «No pasó nada grave y podemos seguir adelante.»
repaso.respuesta: No real harm was done and we can move on
repaso.feedback: No real harm was done resta importancia y and we can move on cierra el asunto sin reproches.

repaso.consigna: Completa: «Es amable dejarlo libre de culpa y seguir adelante.»
repaso.texto: Everyone makes mistakes at work. When a colleague slips, it is kind to ___ him off the hook and simply move on.
repaso.feedback: Let someone off the hook es la expresión para librar a alguien de la culpa; take o get him off the hook también existen.

classes.objetivo: Responder a peticiones difíciles sin comprometerse ni cerrar la puerta, con fórmulas corteses como bear in mind y get back to you.

ensenanza.en: Thank you; I will bear in mind what you said, but I cannot promise anything at this stage.
ensenanza.es: Gracias; tendré en cuenta lo que dijiste, pero no puedo prometer nada por ahora.
ensenanza.nota: Bear in mind = tener en cuenta; con can't promise el resto va en positivo: anything, no nothing.

ensenanza.en: That is worth considering, so let me get back to you next week once I have checked the budget.
ensenanza.es: Eso merece ser considerado, así que déjame responderte la semana próxima cuando haya revisado el presupuesto.
ensenanza.nota: Worth considering reconoce la idea sin aceptarla; let me get back to you fija un plazo para responder.

ensenanza.en: I would rather not commit to a date yet; I want to keep my options open until the schedule is clearer.
ensenanza.es: Prefiero no comprometerme con una fecha todavía; quiero dejar mis opciones abiertas hasta que el horario esté más claro.
ensenanza.nota: Commit to + sustantivo (a date); keep my options open explica por qué no decides aún.

ensenanza.en: It depends on the weather and the team, so I would prefer to hold off on a final decision until Friday.
ensenanza.es: Depende del clima y del equipo, así que preferiría aplazar la decisión final hasta el viernes.
ensenanza.nota: Depends se une a on (nunca of); hold off on = aplazar, dejar algo para más adelante.

ensenanza.en: Thanks for the suggestion; a polite holding reply like this can buy some time without closing the door.
ensenanza.es: Gracias por la sugerencia; una respuesta cortés como esta puede ganar tiempo sin cerrar la puerta.
ensenanza.nota: Buy some time = ganar tiempo; la respuesta no compromete, pero tampoco ofende.

ensenanza.en: I can't promise anything, which leaves the door open, whereas saying that it is impossible would close it.
ensenanza.es: No puedo prometer nada, lo cual deja la puerta abierta, mientras que decir que es imposible la cerraría.
ensenanza.nota: Una respuesta no comprometida evita tanto el sí como el no rotundo: deja abierta la posibilidad.

explicacion.titulo: Dejar la puerta abierta sin prometer
explicacion.texto: Cuando no puedes o no quieres decir ni sí ni no todavía, el inglés cortés usa respuestas que no comprometen: I'll bear that in mind («lo tendré en cuenta»), Let me get back to you («ya te respondo»), I can't promise anything, It depends on…, I'd rather hold off at this stage. Dejan la puerta abierta sin mentir: no dices «sí», dices «aún no lo sé». Así mantienes la relación y ganas tiempo. Cuidado con la gramática: bear that in mind, depends on, y con can't promise el resto va en positivo: anything, no nothing.

formula.nota: avisas de que no hay garantía

formula.texto: let me get back to you on Friday.

filas.texto: I don't want to commit to a date yet.
Let me get back to you.

erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: En español «depende de», pero en inglés depend va con on.
El español admite la doble negación («no prometo nada»); en inglés con una negación basta y se usa anything.

situacion.contexto: Mia pide a Tom que le ayude a pintar el local del club el sábado.

dialogo.texto: Tom, could you help me paint the club room on Saturday?
dialogo.traduccion: Tom, ¿podrías ayudarme a pintar el local del club el sábado?

dialogo.texto: Thanks for asking. I can't promise anything, but I'll bear it in mind.
dialogo.traduccion: Gracias por preguntar. No puedo prometer nada, pero lo tendré en cuenta.

dialogo.texto: I need to know by Thursday.
dialogo.traduccion: Necesito saberlo para el jueves.

dialogo.texto: It depends on my mum's plans. Let me get back to you on Wednesday.
dialogo.traduccion: Depende de los planes de mi madre. Déjame que te conteste el miércoles.

opciones.es: No promete nada y responderá el miércoles.
Acepta ayudar a pintar el sábado.
Rechaza ayudar porque ya tiene otros planes.

item.feedback: Tom dice «I can't promise anything» y «Let me get back to you on Wednesday»: ni acepta ni rechaza.

guiada.consigna: Elige la respuesta no comprometida pero cortés de Carlos.
opciones: I'll bear that in mind, but I'll have to check the diary first of all.
No, I'm afraid that the minibus is never available at weekends at all.
Of course, it's yours whenever you like, there's no problem at all.
guiada.texto: Tom has just asked Carlos to lend him the club's minibus for a weekend trip. Carlos has not checked the booking diary yet and does not want to refuse or promise anything.
guiada.feedback: Carlos no dice sí ni no: toma nota de la petición y fija un paso previo; las otras respuestas o cierran la puerta o prometen demasiado.
guiada.pista: Busca la respuesta que ni acepta ni rechaza y deja una acción pendiente.

guiada.consigna: Completa: «Depende del presupuesto; te respondo el viernes.»
guiada.texto: Mia asked whether the club could pay for the trip. It ___ on the budget, and I said that I would get back to her on Friday.
guiada.feedback: Depends se construye con on y marca que la respuesta queda condicionada.
guiada.pista: Verbo en tercera persona; va seguido de on.

guiada.consigna: Ordena: «No puedo prometer nada en esta etapa.»
guiada.respuesta: I cannot promise anything at this stage
aceptadas: At this stage I cannot promise anything
guiada.feedback: Con cannot promise el resto va en positivo (anything) y at this stage sitúa la respuesta en el tiempo.
guiada.pista: Empieza por I cannot y usa anything, no nothing.

practica.consigna: Escucha y elige qué hace la hablante con la petición de su vecino.
practica.audio: When my neighbour asked me to speak at the street party, I did not want to say no, but I could not say yes either. So I told him I would bear it in mind, that it depended on my week at work, and that I would get back to him on Tuesday. He seemed perfectly happy.
opciones: She neither accepts nor refuses, and names a day for her answer.
She postpones her answer because she wants to prepare the speech first.
She accepts in principle but asks him to confirm the date on Tuesday.
She refuses politely, blaming her busy week at work.
practica.feedback: La hablante ni acepta ni rechaza: «bear it in mind», «depended on my week» y una fecha para responder; el trabajo es la condición, no el motivo de un rechazo.

practica.consigna: ¿Qué respuesta deja la puerta abierta sin prometer nada?
opciones: Possibly; I can't promise anything, but let me check and call you this evening.
Yes, of course, I will be there at nine sharp, so don't worry at all.
I'm afraid that's impossible, and I never work on Saturdays anyway.
Maybe I'll come, maybe I won't; it isn't really my problem, is it?
practica.texto: A colleague asks Sara to cover her Saturday shift and needs an answer today. Sara has a family lunch that might run late, so she cannot be sure of anything.
practica.feedback: Es cortés, no promete y fija un momento para responder; las demás aceptan del todo, cierran del todo o suenan descorteses.

practica.consigna: Completa: «No quiero comprometerme con una fecha todavía.»
practica.texto: I'd love to help with the fundraiser, but I do not want to ___ to a date yet. I'll keep my options open until the rota is confirmed.
practica.feedback: Commit to + fecha significa comprometerse con ella; agree to también sería posible, pero commit es la fórmula de este tema.

evaluacion.consigna: Según el correo de Mia, ¿qué le pide a Leo?
opciones: More time, so that she can decide without letting the group down.
A lighter role on the committee than the one he offered.
A copy of the minutes, since she cannot attend the next meeting.
Permission to join the committee for one meeting only.
evaluacion.texto: Hi Leo, thanks for inviting me to join the planning committee. I'm flattered, and it is certainly worth considering. That said, I'm not sure my workload will allow it this term, and I would hate to say yes and then let the group down. Could you give me until the end of the month? In the meantime I'll keep my options open and read the minutes, so that I can contribute properly if I do join. I can't promise anything, but I'll get back to you before the next meeting. Best wishes, Mia
evaluacion.feedback: Mia pide plazo hasta final de mes para decidir sin fallar al grupo; la lectura de las actas es lo que hará mientras tanto.

evaluacion.consigna: ¿Qué sugiere el correo de Mia sobre sus probabilidades de aceptar?
opciones: That she is seriously considering it but will not commit until certain.
That she has already decided to refuse and is only being polite.
That she will accept as soon as her workload becomes lighter.
That she needs Leo to persuade her with a better offer.
evaluacion.texto: Hi Leo, thanks for inviting me to join the planning committee. I'm flattered, and it is certainly worth considering. That said, I'm not sure my workload will allow it this term, and I would hate to say yes and then let the group down. Could you give me until the end of the month? In the meantime I'll keep my options open and read the minutes, so that I can contribute properly if I do join. I can't promise anything, but I'll get back to you before the next meeting. Best wishes, Mia
evaluacion.feedback: Llama a la idea «worth considering», lee las actas y mantiene sus opciones abiertas: valora aceptar, pero no se compromete hasta estar segura.

evaluacion.consigna: Completa: «Deberíamos aplazar la decisión final hasta que se apruebe el presupuesto.»
evaluacion.texto: We should ___ off on the final decision until the budget is approved. Nobody wants to commit to a date that may have to change.
evaluacion.feedback: Hold off on significa aplazar una decisión; se mantiene la puerta abierta hasta tener datos.

evaluacion.consigna: Responde sin comprometerte a la petición de una vecina.
evaluacion.texto: Una vecina te pide que cuides su perro el fin de semana largo y aún no sabes si viajarás. Di que lo tendrás en cuenta, que no puedes prometer nada todavía y que le contestarás el lunes.
evaluacion.respuesta: Thanks for asking. I'll bear that in mind, but I can't promise anything at this stage. Let me get back to you on Monday.
aceptadas: Thank you for thinking of me. I will bear it in mind, but it depends on my plans, so I can't promise anything yet. I'll get back to you on Monday.
That's kind of you. I'll keep that in mind, but I cannot guarantee anything just yet. I'll let you know on Monday.
evaluacion.feedback: La respuesta combina reconocimiento, advertencia de que no hay garantía y un plazo para contestar.

repaso.consigna: ¿Qué da a entender realmente el remitente en esta respuesta?
opciones: That a change of date is possible but has not been agreed.
That the suggestion has been rejected, but in a very polite manner overall.
That the workshop will move to July once the board meets.
That the board has already refused to fund the workshop.
repaso.texto: Dear Sara, thanks for the suggestion about moving the workshop to July. It is an interesting idea and I will certainly bear it in mind. At this stage, though, the budget has not been approved, and I would not want to promise a date that I cannot guarantee. Let me get back to you after the board meets next Tuesday.
repaso.feedback: Reconoce la idea, pero sin presupuesto aprobado no promete fecha y pospone la respuesta: algo posible pero aún no acordado.

repaso.respuesta: It depends on the budget so let me get back to you
repaso.feedback: Depends on introduce la condición y let me get back to you deja la respuesta para más tarde.

repaso.consigna: Escucha y elige qué responde la hablante a la petición del auto.
repaso.audio: She asked whether I could lend her the car for the weekend. I said it depended on my brother, who has the keys, and that I couldn't promise anything. I told her I would get back to her before Friday evening.
opciones: It is uncertain, and she will reply to her friend by Friday night.
She has promised the car, pending a word with her brother.
She cannot lend it because her brother needs it himself for the weekend.
She advises her friend to ask her brother directly, as he holds the keys.
repaso.feedback: La hablante no promete nada, depende de su hermano y fija un plazo para contestar: respuesta no comprometida.

classes.objetivo: Leer un comunicado entre dos asociaciones y traducir sus frases diplomáticas a lenguaje directo, repasando las preguntas reportadas.

vocabulario.es: un intercambio franco, una discusión dura
quedarse a las puertas de, no llegar a

ensenanza.en: When a statement says that the association will take note of your complaint, it may simply mean that it has heard you.
ensenanza.es: Cuando un comunicado dice que la asociación tomará nota de tu queja, puede significar simplemente que te ha escuchado.
ensenanza.nota: Take note of = tomar nota: reconoce que recibió el mensaje, pero no promete actuar.

ensenanza.en: In a statement, a frank exchange of views is code for a disagreement that was heated, even if nobody shouted.
ensenanza.es: En un comunicado, un intercambio franco de opiniones es una forma cifrada de decir que hubo un desacuerdo acalorado, aunque nadie gritara.
ensenanza.nota: Frank suena amable, pero suele esconder una discusión dura; code for = forma cifrada de decir.

ensenanza.en: We note with concern that the garden has still not been cleaned, which reads as a polite complaint.
ensenanza.es: Observamos con preocupación que el jardín sigue sin limpiarse, lo que se lee como una queja cortés.
ensenanza.nota: We note with concern = estamos preocupados y queremos que cambie; la queja va envuelta en una fórmula neutra.

ensenanza.en: We regret that the meeting ended early, yet what is on the record is sorrow, not an admission of fault.
ensenanza.es: Lamentamos que la reunión terminara pronto, pero lo que consta oficialmente es pena, no una admisión de culpa.
ensenanza.nota: Regret expresa pesar sin reconocer responsabilidad; on the record = lo que queda dicho oficialmente.

ensenanza.en: The association may remain committed to talks and still stop short of any concession, so read between the lines.
ensenanza.es: La asociación puede seguir comprometida con el diálogo y aun así no llegar a ninguna concesión, así que lee entre líneas.
ensenanza.nota: Remain committed = seguir en la mesa; stop short of = no llegar a; read between the lines = leer lo no dicho.

ensenanza.en: The committee asked whether the association would reconsider its decision, which is a polite way of saying that it should.
ensenanza.es: El comité preguntó si la asociación reconsideraría su decisión, que es una forma cortés de decir que debería hacerlo.
ensenanza.nota: En una pregunta reportada el orden es afirmativo (whether + sujeto + verbo); aquí la pregunta funciona como petición.

explicacion.titulo: Lo que dicen de verdad los comunicados
explicacion.texto: Los comunicados diplomáticos dicen cosas duras con palabras suaves. We note with concern equivale a «estamos preocupados y queremos que cambie»; a frank exchange of views, a «discutimos con dureza»; we regret, a «lamentamos lo ocurrido» (sin admitir culpa); we remain committed to…, a «seguimos dispuestos, pero no hay acuerdo». Para interpretar, busca el verbo emocional, lee entre líneas y fíjate en lo que falta: ¿hay disculpa?, ¿hay fecha? Las preguntas que citan a otros mantienen el orden afirmativo: asked whether the association would reconsider.

formula.nota: = estamos preocupados y queremos un cambio
= un desacuerdo fuerte, dicho con claridad
= seguimos en la mesa, sin acuerdo aún

filas.texto: Estamos preocupados y queremos que cambie
Lamentamos lo ocurrido y nos afecta
Seguimos queriendo resolverlo, sin acuerdo aún

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: The committee asked whether would the association reconsider.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: The committee asked whether the association would reconsider.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: En una pregunta reportada el orden es afirmativo: sujeto + verbo. La inversión solo va en la pregunta directa.

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: We remain committed with finding a solution.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: We remain committed to finding a solution.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Committed se une a to, no a with, aunque en español digamos «comprometidos con».

situacion.contexto: Sara y Carlos leen un comunicado entre la asociación del jardín y el club del barrio.

dialogo.texto: Look at the statement. It says the two groups held frank discussions.
dialogo.traduccion: Mira el comunicado. Dice que los dos grupos mantuvieron conversaciones francas.

dialogo.texto: That usually means they argued. What else does it say?
dialogo.traduccion: Eso suele significar que discutieron. ¿Qué más dice?

dialogo.texto: It notes with concern that the garden is not clean, and it says they remain committed to finding a solution.
dialogo.traduccion: Observa con preocupación que el jardín no está limpio, y dice que siguen comprometidos con encontrar una solución.

dialogo.texto: So they are unhappy, but they still want to talk.
dialogo.traduccion: Es decir, están descontentos, pero quieren seguir hablando.

item.consigna: Según el diálogo, ¿qué significa «frank discussions» para Carlos?

opciones.es: Que los dos grupos discutieron con dureza.
Que los dos grupos se pusieron de acuerdo.
Que los dos grupos no llegaron a hablar.

item.feedback: Carlos explica «That usually means they argued»: lo franco esconde un desacuerdo fuerte.

guiada.consigna: ¿Qué significa realmente «a frank exchange of views» en este comunicado?
opciones: The two sides disagreed strongly and said so openly to each other.
The two sides agreed on most points and spoke informally.
The two sides avoided the subject and talked about other matters.
guiada.texto: The Garden Association and the Youth Club issued a shared statement after Tuesday's meeting. It said that the two sides had held a frank exchange of views and that both remained committed to a solution.
guiada.feedback: En lenguaje diplomático, franco suele esconder un desacuerdo abierto: hubo discusión, no acuerdo ni evasión.
guiada.pista: Frank suena amable, pero en un comunicado suele ser código de discusión dura.

guiada.consigna: Completa: «Observamos con preocupación que el jardín sigue sin limpiarse.»
guiada.texto: The letter said: «We note with ___ that the garden has still not been cleaned.» In plain terms, the writers are worried and want a change.
guiada.feedback: We note with concern traduce una queja como preocupación oficial; regret o dismay serían variantes posibles.
guiada.pista: Sustantivo que significa «preocupación»; empieza por c.

guiada.consigna: Ordena: «El club preguntó si reconsideraríamos la fecha.»
guiada.respuesta: The club asked whether we would reconsider the date
guiada.feedback: La pregunta reportada mantiene el orden afirmativo: whether + we + would reconsider.
guiada.pista: Empieza por The club asked whether y sigue sin inversión.

practica.consigna: Escucha y elige qué se puede deducir del comunicado.
practica.audio: The two associations issued a shared statement. It says that they regret the misunderstanding, that discussions were frank, and that both remain committed to finding a way forward. It does not say who was at fault, and it does not promise any change in the timetable.
opciones: That the dispute continues, although both sides want to keep talking.
That the dispute has ended and the timetable will now change for good.
That one association admits that it was at fault.
That the two associations have stopped speaking to each other.
practica.feedback: Lamentar, conversaciones francas y seguir comprometidos sugieren un conflicto abierto con voluntad de diálogo; no hay culpa admitida ni cambios.

practica.consigna: Relaciona cada frase del comunicado con lo que significa en lenguaje directo.
pares: We note with concern that the garden is not clean
Estamos preocupados y queremos un cambio
The two sides held a frank exchange of views
Hubo una discusión dura
We regret that the talks ended early
Lamentamos que acabaran, sin admitir culpa
We remain committed to a solution
Seguimos queriendo resolverlo, sin acuerdo aún
We will take note of your complaint
Lo hemos oído, pero no prometemos actuar
practica.feedback: Cada fórmula esconde un mensaje directo: preocupación con exigencia, discusión dura, pesar sin culpa, voluntad sin acuerdo y escucha sin promesa.

practica.consigna: ¿Cómo debe interpretarse este comunicado de la asociación?
opciones: As a polite reply that postpones the matter without offering anything concrete.
As a full apology that accepts the complaint made by the club.
As a firm rejection of every request that the club has made.
As a promise to announce a decision within a few days.
practica.texto: The statement praises the club's constructive spirit and says that the association will keep the matter under review. It stops short of apologising and gives no date for any decision. Members who hoped for a clear answer may feel that they have been thanked rather than answered.
practica.feedback: Agradece, mantiene el asunto «under review» y no da fecha ni disculpa: pospone sin ofrecer nada concreto.

evaluacion.consigna: Escucha el comunicado y elige qué quiere decir «a frank exchange of views».
evaluacion.audio: The two associations published a shared statement on Friday after weeks of tension over the shared garden. It begins by noting with concern that the paths have not been cleaned. It goes on to say that the two boards held a frank exchange of views, and that both remain committed to a solution. Finally, it regrets that the meeting ended early, without saying who left first. Residents who read between the lines will notice what is missing: there is no apology, no date for the next meeting, and no mention of the rent that started the argument.
opciones: That the two boards argued openly and did not agree.
That the two boards agreed to share the garden equally.
That the two boards swapped letters instead of meeting.
That the two boards chatted informally about the paths.
evaluacion.feedback: En el comunicado, frank esconde un desacuerdo abierto: por eso no hay acuerdo ni disculpa después.

evaluacion.consigna: Escucha de nuevo: ¿qué sugiere la ausencia de disculpa y de fecha?
evaluacion.audio: The two associations published a shared statement on Friday after weeks of tension over the shared garden. It begins by noting with concern that the paths have not been cleaned. It goes on to say that the two boards held a frank exchange of views, and that both remain committed to a solution. Finally, it regrets that the meeting ended early, without saying who left first. Residents who read between the lines will notice what is missing: there is no apology, no date for the next meeting, and no mention of the rent that started the argument.
opciones: That the dispute is unresolved and neither side has moved.
That the dispute is over and needs no further comment.
That the residents will organise the next meeting themselves.
That the rent is now the only issue left to resolve.
evaluacion.feedback: Sin disculpa ni fecha, leer entre líneas indica que el conflicto sigue abierto y que ninguna parte ha cedido.

evaluacion.consigna: Completa: «La junta tomará nota de su queja, lo que no significa que actúe.»
evaluacion.texto: The board will ___ note of your complaint, but that does not mean that it will act on it, or even that it agrees with it.
evaluacion.feedback: Take note of es la fórmula de escucha sin compromiso; make note of también se usa.

evaluacion.consigna: Traduce a lenguaje directo: «We note with concern that the rent has not been paid.»
evaluacion.texto: We note with concern that the rent has not been paid.
evaluacion.respuesta: We are worried that nobody has paid the rent, and we want it paid soon.
aceptadas: We are concerned that the rent has not been paid, and we expect you to pay it soon.

evidencias: the rent has not been paid

evaluacion.feedback: La traducción directa convierte la fórmula neutra en preocupación y exigencia: estamos preocupados y queremos que se pague.

repaso.consigna: ¿Qué mensaje real transmite la junta en esta carta?
opciones: That it will not change the arrangements for now and will say no more.
That it accepts the complaint and will change the rules before the summer.
That it shares the residents' concerns and wants to act on them quickly.
That it will meet the association soon to negotiate a new agreement.
repaso.texto: Dear Residents' Association, we have read your letter with interest and we take note of your concerns. Our board will keep the matter under review and remains committed to open dialogue. We would, however, remind you that the current arrangements were agreed in good faith, and we are not in a position to comment further at this stage.
repaso.feedback: Agradece y «keeps under review», pero recuerda que lo pactado se acordó de buena fe y no comentará más: no cambiará nada por ahora.

repaso.consigna: Ordena: «Preguntaron si seguimos comprometidos con el plan.»
repaso.respuesta: They asked whether we remain committed to the plan
repaso.feedback: En la pregunta reportada, whether + sujeto + verbo mantiene el orden afirmativo.

repaso.consigna: Completa: «Dijeron solo que lamentan el malentendido.»
repaso.texto: Officials declined to say who was at fault. They said only that they ___ the misunderstanding and hoped that talks could continue.
repaso.feedback: Regret expresa pesar sin reconocer culpa, justo lo que hace un comunicado prudente.

classes.objetivo: Escribir una queja suave y una petición indirecta a un compañero de departamento, con wish o if only y una pregunta reportada.

vocabulario.es: dejar que los problemas se acumulen

ensenanza.en: Lately, the kitchen has been a mess, and I would rather bring up the problem now than let things build up.
ensenanza.es: Últimamente la cocina ha estado hecha un desastre, y prefiero sacar el problema ahora antes que dejar que las cosas se acumulen.
ensenanza.nota: Lately describe el problema sin acusar a nadie; bring up y let things build up explican por qué hablas ahora.

ensenanza.en: I wish you would wash your dishes on the same day; I do not mean to criticise, only to clear the air.
ensenanza.es: Ojalá lavaras tus platos el mismo día; no pretendo criticar, solo aclarar las cosas.
ensenanza.nota: Wish + would expresa un deseo sobre una conducta que molesta; clear the air = aclarar las cosas.

ensenanza.en: I was wondering if you could keep the noise down after eleven; you are usually so considerate that I hesitated to ask.
ensenanza.es: Me preguntaba si podrías bajar el ruido después de las once; sueles ser tan considerado que dudé en pedírtelo.
ensenanza.nota: I was wondering if + sujeto + could: petición indirecta; el orden es afirmativo, sin inversión.

ensenanza.en: I would really appreciate it if you could do a fair share of the cleaning, since we all use the kitchen.
ensenanza.es: Te agradecería mucho que pudieras hacer una parte justa de la limpieza, ya que todos usamos la cocina.
ensenanza.nota: I would appreciate it if you could… es una petición muy cortés; a fair share apela a la justicia, no a la culpa.

ensenanza.en: Please don't take it the wrong way, but if only the rota were clearer, nobody would need to complain.
ensenanza.es: Por favor, no te lo tomes a mal, pero si el calendario de turnos fuera más claro, nadie tendría que quejarse.
ensenanza.nota: If only + pasado expresa un deseo sobre una situación; take it the wrong way = tomárselo a mal.

ensenanza.en: Mia asked me whether we could agree on a rota, and I think her suggestion is a fair one.
ensenanza.es: Mia me preguntó si podíamos acordar un calendario de turnos, y creo que su sugerencia es justa.
ensenanza.nota: La pregunta reportada con whether mantiene el orden afirmativo y retrocede can a could.

explicacion.texto: Una queja suave tiene tres piezas. Primero describe el problema sin acusar: Lately, the kitchen has been a mess. Después expresa el deseo con wish + would (una conducta que molesta: I wish you would…) o if only + pasado (una situación: If only the walls were thicker). Por último pide de forma indirecta: I was wondering if you could… / I would appreciate it if you could… Para citar lo que otra persona preguntó, usa una pregunta reportada con whether o if y orden afirmativo. Y si hace falta, suaviza con Please don't take it the wrong way.

formula.texto: Lately, the kitchen has been a mess.
I wish you would wash up on the same day.
formula.nota: deseo: wish + would para una conducta

formula.texto: I was wondering if you could tidy it tonight.
Mia asked whether we could agree on a rota.

filas.texto: Lately, the noise has been loud.
I wish you would knock first.
If only the walls were thicker.
I was wondering if you could…
I was wondering if you could help.

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: I wish you will wash the dishes on the same day.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: I wish you would wash the dishes on the same day.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Tras wish el verbo retrocede: will pasa a would, igual que el español usa el imperfecto de subjuntivo.

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: I was wondering if could you keep the music down.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: I was wondering if you could keep the music down.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Después de I was wondering if el orden es afirmativo: sujeto + could; no se invierte como en una pregunta directa.

situacion.contexto: Ana y Leo comparten departamento y ella le pide con tacto que baje la música.

dialogo.texto: Leo, I was wondering if you could keep the music down after eleven.
dialogo.traduccion: Leo, me preguntaba si podrías bajar la música después de las once.

dialogo.texto: Oh, sorry. I didn't realise it was so loud.
dialogo.traduccion: Ay, perdona. No me di cuenta de que estaba tan alta.

dialogo.texto: It's fine. I wish you would use your headphones late at night, though.
dialogo.traduccion: No pasa nada. Aunque ojalá usaras auriculares por la noche.

dialogo.texto: Good idea. I would appreciate it if you told me next time.
dialogo.traduccion: Buena idea. Te agradecería que me lo dijeras la próxima vez.

item.consigna: Según el diálogo, ¿qué le pide Ana a Leo?

opciones.es: Que baje la música después de las once y use auriculares.
Que apague la música todo el día.
Que se mude a otro departamento.

item.feedback: Ana pide bajar la música con «I was wondering if…» y añade «I wish you would use your headphones».

guiada.consigna: Elige el mensaje que se queja con tacto, sin acusar a nadie.
opciones: Lately the sink has been full; I wish we could agree on a rota.
You never wash up, and I am tired of cleaning after you every day.
Everyone knows that you are the messiest person in the building.
guiada.texto: Leo's flatmate has left dishes in the sink for three days. Leo wants to raise the problem without starting an argument.
guiada.feedback: La queja suave describe el problema con Lately y propone una solución con wish; los otros mensajes acusan con you never o con un insulto.
guiada.pista: Busca el mensaje que describe el problema y propone algo, sin you never.

guiada.consigna: Completa: «Ojalá usaras auriculares por la noche.»
guiada.texto: The walls are thin and the music is loud after midnight. I wish you ___ use your headphones late at night.
guiada.feedback: Wish + would expresa un deseo sobre una conducta repetida que molesta.
guiada.pista: Modal de deseo sobre una conducta; empieza por w.

guiada.consigna: Ordena: «Me preguntaba si podrías ordenar la cocina esta noche.»
guiada.respuesta: I was wondering if you could tidy the kitchen tonight
aceptadas: I was wondering if tonight you could tidy the kitchen
guiada.feedback: I was wondering if + sujeto + could + verbo: petición indirecta con orden afirmativo.
guiada.pista: Empieza por I was wondering if y sigue sin invertir.

practica.consigna: Escucha y elige qué busca Leo con su mensaje.
practica.audio: Hi Sam, it's Leo. Lately the flat has been a bit of a mess in the evenings, and I wondered whether we could agree on a rota. I don't want to blame anyone; I just wish we could keep it tidy together. Would Sunday suit you for a quick chat?
opciones: To propose a fairer way to share the cleaning without blaming Sam.
To warn Sam that he will stop cleaning unless the rota changes.
To apologise for the mess that he has left in the flat lately.
To arrange a chat on Sunday so that Sam can explain himself.
practica.feedback: Leo describe el problema, propone un turno y aclara que no culpa a nadie: busca repartir la limpieza; la charla del domingo es solo el medio, no el fin.

practica.consigna: Elige la pregunta de Mia bien reportada.
opciones: Mia asked whether we could agree on a rota.
Mia asked whether could we agree on a rota.
Mia asked that we could agree on a rota.
practica.texto: Mia asked the flatmates: «Can we agree on a rota?»
practica.feedback: Una pregunta reportada con whether mantiene el orden afirmativo; la inversión y that + could son errores.

practica.consigna: Reformula la petición de forma indirecta con I was wondering if.
practica.respuesta: I was wondering if you could turn the music down.
aceptadas: I was wondering whether you could turn the music down.
I was wondering if you would turn the music down.
I was wondering if you could turn down the music.
practica.feedback: La petición directa se suaviza con I was wondering if + sujeto + could + verbo.

evaluacion.consigna: ¿Qué pretende Ana con su mensaje a Leo?
opciones: To raise a small problem politely and suggest a shared solution.
To complain about Leo's behaviour and demand a formal apology.
To announce that Mia will draw up the cleaning rota alone.
To ask Leo for the money he owes for the shared cleaning supplies.
evaluacion.texto: Hi Leo, I hope your exams are going well. I wanted to mention something small before it grows. Lately the hall has been full of bags, and I have nearly tripped twice. I'm sure you don't notice it, and I certainly don't want you to take this the wrong way. I wish we had a place for them, and I was wondering if you could keep your things in your room during the week. I would really appreciate it, and I'll do the same with my shoes. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a cleaning rota too, which might help us both. Shall we chat on Sunday? Thanks, Ana
evaluacion.feedback: Ana describe un problema pequeño, evita acusar y propone una solución compartida; no exige disculpas ni anuncia decisiones.

evaluacion.consigna: ¿Qué sugiere Ana con la frase «I'll do the same with my shoes»?
opciones: That she accepts causing some mess too and will change her habits.
That she wants Leo to feel guilty by comparing his bags with her shoes.
That she thinks the mess in the hall is entirely Leo's fault.
That she plans to buy a new shelf to settle the matter.
evaluacion.texto: Hi Leo, I hope your exams are going well. I wanted to mention something small before it grows. Lately the hall has been full of bags, and I have nearly tripped twice. I'm sure you don't notice it, and I certainly don't want you to take this the wrong way. I wish we had a place for them, and I was wondering if you could keep your things in your room during the week. I would really appreciate it, and I'll do the same with my shoes. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a cleaning rota too, which might help us both. Shall we chat on Sunday? Thanks, Ana
evaluacion.feedback: Al ofrecerse a hacer lo mismo, Ana reconoce su parte del problema y reparte la responsabilidad en vez de culpar solo a Leo.

evaluacion.consigna: Completa: «No quería sacar el tema del calendario de turnos delante de todos.»
evaluacion.texto: I didn't want to ___ up the subject of the rota in front of everyone, so I sent Mia a private message instead.
evaluacion.feedback: Bring up + the subject es el verbo frasal habitual para sacar un tema; fíjate en que up ya está en la frase.

evaluacion.consigna: Escribe a Sam: problema, deseo, petición indirecta, pregunta reportada y cierre.
evaluacion.texto: Vives con un compañero, Sam. Escríbele un mensaje de unas 190–250 palabras: describe el problema (cocina desordenada y música tarde) sin acusar; expresa un deseo con wish o if only; haz una petición indirecta con I was wondering if…; incluye una pregunta reportada (Mia te preguntó si podían acordar un turno de limpieza); y termina agradeciendo.
evaluacion.respuesta: Hi Sam, I hope your week is going well. I wanted to bring something up before it gets awkward. Lately the kitchen has been a bit of a mess in the evenings, and the music has been loud after eleven. I'm sure you don't notice it, and please don't take it the wrong way, because I don't want to blame anyone. I wish you would wash your dishes on the same day, and if only the walls were thicker, I would not need to mention the music at all. I was wondering if you could keep the noise down after eleven, and I would really appreciate it if you could tidy up tonight. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a cleaning rota, so that everyone does a fair share, and I think it is a good idea. Could we talk about it this weekend? Thanks for being so considerate; I hope this helps to clear the air.
aceptadas: Hello Sam, I wanted to write to you about the flat before things build up. Lately the kitchen has been untidy, and the music has been loud late at night. I am not angry, and I am sure it is easily done. I wish you would tidy up after cooking, and if only the walls were thicker, it would be easier for me to sleep. I was wondering if you could turn the music down after eleven. I would appreciate it if you could clean the kitchen tonight. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a rota for the cleaning, and I think it would help all of us to share the work in a fair way. Could we talk about it on Sunday? Thank you for understanding, and please tell me if anything bothers you, too.

evidencias: i was wondering if you could
i was wondering whether you could
i would appreciate it if you could
i would really appreciate it if
i would be grateful if you could

evaluacion.feedback: Un buen mensaje describe sin acusar, expresa un deseo, pide de forma indirecta, reporta una pregunta y cierra con agradecimiento.

repaso.consigna: ¿Qué actitud transmite esta nota pegada en la nevera?
opciones: Gentle, naming the problem while avoiding any blame.
Resigned, suggesting that the flatmates will never change their habits.
Apologetic, taking the blame for the state of the kitchen herself.
Firm, presenting the rota as a rule that starts on Monday.
repaso.texto: Dear flatmates, thank you all for being so patient lately. I wish I could say that the kitchen is tidy, but I think we all know that it is not. No one is to blame, and I'm not angry; I just think a rota might save us from ever having this conversation again. Mia asked whether we could try it from Monday. Shall we?
repaso.feedback: Nombra el problema, aclara que nadie tiene la culpa y propone probar un turno con un «Shall we?»: tono suave, no resignado, culpable ni autoritario.

repaso.consigna: Ordena: «Leo preguntó si podía mantener el ruido bajo.»
repaso.respuesta: Leo asked whether I could keep the noise down
repaso.feedback: La pregunta reportada conserva el orden afirmativo: whether + I + could + keep the noise down.

repaso.consigna: Escucha y elige qué sugiere la hablante sobre la basura.
repaso.audio: I don't want to complain, but lately the bins have not been taken out. I wish someone would do it on Thursdays. I was wondering if we could put it on the rota, so that nobody feels they are doing more than a fair share.
opciones: That the bins should be added to the rota so work is shared.
That one flatmate has ignored the bins on purpose for several weeks.
That she will take out the bins herself every Thursday from now on.
That the rota is unfair because she already takes out the bins alone.
repaso.feedback: La hablante describe el problema sin acusar y propone incluir la basura en los turnos para repartir el trabajo.

classes.objetivo: Mediar en una reunión de departamento compartido con tacto: exponer una queja, hacer preguntas indirectas, reportar lo dicho y acordar una norma.

vocabulario.es: escuchar a todos hasta el final

ensenanza.en: I will mediate and chair the meeting; first on the agenda are the chores, and everyone will have two minutes to speak.
ensenanza.es: Voy a mediar y presidir la reunión; lo primero en el orden del día son las tareas domésticas, y cada uno tendrá dos minutos para hablar.
ensenanza.nota: Un mediador abre con orden: anuncia su papel, el orden del día (agenda) y los turnos de palabra.

ensenanza.en: Before we settle anything, I would like to hear everyone out, because a rushed decision rarely keeps the peace.
ensenanza.es: Antes de resolver nada, me gustaría escuchar a todos hasta el final, porque una decisión precipitada rara vez mantiene la paz.
ensenanza.nota: Hear someone out = dejar que termine de hablar; settle = zanjar una disputa.

ensenanza.en: I would like to raise something, and I wish we could iron out the small irritations before they grow.
ensenanza.es: Me gustaría plantear algo, y ojalá pudiéramos limar las pequeñas molestias antes de que crezcan.
ensenanza.nota: Wish + could expresa un deseo sin presionar; iron out = resolver con calma diferencias pequeñas.

ensenanza.en: To mediate well, you must keep the discussion on track and stop one person from speaking for everyone.
ensenanza.es: Para mediar bien hay que mantener la discusión encaminada e impedir que una persona hable en nombre de todos.
ensenanza.nota: Keep the discussion on track = evitar que la conversación se desvíe; el mediador resume y reconduce.

ensenanza.en: I was wondering if we could propose a rota that would help get everyone on board.
ensenanza.es: Me preguntaba si podríamos proponer un calendario de turnos que ayude a conseguir el apoyo de todos.
ensenanza.nota: I was wondering if + sujeto + could: petición indirecta; get everyone on board = lograr que todos apoyen.

ensenanza.en: If only we had agreed on an agenda last month, we might already have a workable solution and a shorter meeting.
ensenanza.es: Si hubiéramos acordado un orden del día el mes pasado, quizá ya tendríamos una solución viable y una reunión más corta.
ensenanza.nota: If only + had + participio lamenta algo pasado; a workable solution = una solución que sí se puede aplicar.

explicacion.titulo: Mediar en la reunión del departamento
explicacion.texto: Mediar es dirigir con tacto: dar turno, escuchar a todos hasta el final, resumir lo dicho y cerrar con un acuerdo. Combina lo visto en el bloque: la queja suave (I wish you would…, If only…), las peticiones y preguntas indirectas (I was wondering if…, Could I ask whether…?), las preguntas reportadas (Mia asked whether…) y las fórmulas para reconocer al otro y no comprometerse antes de tiempo. Antes de acordar, resume qué ha dicho cada uno; al final, cierra con una pregunta de acuerdo: Are we all happy with that?

patron.texto: Abrir + queja suave + pregunta indirecta + acuerdo:

formula.texto: Let me mediate; first on the agenda: the chores.
formula.nota: abres la reunión y das orden

formula.texto: I wish we could settle this today.
Could I ask whether everyone agrees?
Are we all happy to start the rota on Monday?

filas.texto: Let me mediate; everyone has two minutes.
I wish we could settle the chores today.
Could I ask whether everyone agrees?

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: I wish we can settle it today.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: I wish we could settle it today.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Tras wish el verbo retrocede: can pasa a could. Wish + can no existe en inglés.

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: Mia asked whether could we settle the chores tonight.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: Mia asked whether we could settle the chores tonight.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: En la pregunta reportada el orden es afirmativo: sujeto + could; la inversión queda para la pregunta directa.

situacion.contexto: Sara dirige la reunión de su departamento compartido, con Carlos y Ana.

dialogo.texto: Let me mediate. First on the agenda: the chores.
dialogo.traduccion: Déjenme mediar. Lo primero en el orden del día: las tareas.

dialogo.texto: I was wondering if we could have a rota. The kitchen has been a mess.
dialogo.traduccion: Me preguntaba si podríamos tener un calendario de turnos. La cocina ha estado hecha un desastre.

dialogo.texto: I wish we could settle it tonight. Mia asked me whether we could start on Monday.
dialogo.traduccion: Ojalá pudiéramos zanjarlo esta noche. Mia me preguntó si podíamos empezar el lunes.

dialogo.texto: Fair enough. Shall we propose a rota from Monday?
dialogo.traduccion: Me parece justo. ¿Proponemos un calendario de turnos desde el lunes?

item.consigna: Según el diálogo, ¿qué proponen al final?

opciones.es: Empezar un cuadrante de tareas el lunes.
Dejar las tareas para el mes próximo.

item.feedback: Sara resume: «Shall we propose a rota from Monday?», recogiendo lo que pidieron Carlos y Ana.

guiada.consigna: Elige la frase con la que Sara abre bien la reunión como mediadora.
opciones: Let me chair the meeting: the chores come first, and everyone has two minutes.
I am only here because nobody else wanted to, so let us get this over quickly.
Before we start, let me say that most of the mess is obviously Leo's fault.
guiada.texto: Four flatmates are about to meet about the chores. Sara has offered to mediate, and she wants to open the meeting calmly.
guiada.feedback: Una mediadora ordena el turno y el orden del día sin culpar a nadie; las otras frases muestran desgana o señalan a un culpable.
guiada.pista: El mediador ordena turnos y orden del día, sin culpar.

guiada.consigna: Completa: «Antes de decidir, quiere escuchar a todos hasta el final.»
guiada.texto: Some of the flatmates have not spoken yet. Before the group settles anything, Sara says that she would like to ___ everyone out.
guiada.feedback: Hear everyone out significa dejar que todos terminen de hablar antes de decidir.
guiada.pista: Verbo de percepción auditiva; empieza por h.

guiada.consigna: Ordena: «¿Podría preguntar si todos están de acuerdo con el calendario?»
guiada.respuesta: Could I ask whether everyone agrees with the rota
guiada.feedback: Could I ask whether + sujeto + verbo: la pregunta indirecta mantiene el orden afirmativo.
guiada.pista: Empieza por Could I ask whether y sigue sin inversión.

practica.consigna: Escucha y elige cómo mantiene Sol el orden en la reunión.
practica.audio: Sol chaired the meeting calmly. When Tom began to interrupt, she thanked him and reminded him that each person would get two minutes. She then summed up what Mar had said, so that nobody felt ignored, and asked whether anyone wanted to add anything before the group moved on to the rota.
opciones: By reminding everyone of the turns and summing up what was said.
By cutting Tom off firmly and moving straight to the rota.
By proposing a rota herself and asking everyone to vote at once.
By giving Mar more time than the others because she was the quietest.
practica.feedback: Sol recuerda los turnos y resume lo dicho por Mar, de modo que nadie se sienta ignorado; no corta a Tom, no impone el calendario ni favorece a nadie.

practica.consigna: Relaciona cada frase de la reunión con su función.
pares: Let me chair the meeting; first on the agenda are the chores
Abrir y dar orden
I would like to raise something that has bothered me lately
Plantear una queja suave
Could I ask whether everyone is happy with Monday?
Pregunta indirecta para comprobar acuerdo
Mia asked whether we could start a rota
Reportar lo que preguntó otra persona
Shall we propose a rota from Monday?
Proponer un acuerdo concreto
practica.feedback: Cada frase cumple un paso de la mediación: abrir, plantear, preguntar con tacto, reportar y proponer.

practica.consigna: ¿Qué sugiere esta nota sobre el método del mediador?
opciones: That he wants a workable compromise rather than a winner.
That he favours Leo's flexible task but prefers not to say so yet.
That he will let the flatmates argue until they get tired.
That he thinks a trial would only waste everyone's time.
practica.texto: Both sides have a point: Ana wants a fixed cleaning day, and Leo prefers a flexible weekly task. I will not choose between them yet. Instead, I will ask each of them to say what they could live with, and then I'll propose a two-week trial.
practica.feedback: No elige entre las dos posturas: pide a cada uno qué aceptaría y propone una prueba de dos semanas, buscando un término medio viable.

evaluacion.consigna: Escucha el relato y elige cómo reacciona Leo ante la idea del calendario.
evaluacion.audio: Sara called the flat meeting for eight o'clock. She began by saying that she would mediate, not judge, and that first on the agenda were the chores. Carlos raised the kitchen: lately, he said, he had washed other people's plates three times, and he wished someone would notice. Ana replied that she had not realised, and asked whether a rota might help. Leo was not convinced. He said rotas sound fine on paper, but nobody follows them, and he did not want to promise anything. Sara let him finish, then asked if he would try it for two weeks. He agreed, although only after she promised that they would review it at the end of the month.
opciones: Doubtful at first, but willing to try it for a limited time.
Reluctant, and he agrees only because Ana pressed him to accept.
Sceptical throughout, accepting only a rota that is never reviewed.
Bored, agreeing simply to end the meeting sooner.
evaluacion.feedback: Leo duda de que alguien cumpla un calendario y no quiere prometer nada, pero acepta probarlo dos semanas con revisión; nadie le presiona y su condición es precisamente la revisión.

evaluacion.consigna: Escucha de nuevo: ¿qué sugiere el relato sobre el estilo de Sara como mediadora?
evaluacion.audio: Sara called the flat meeting for eight o'clock. She began by saying that she would mediate, not judge, and that first on the agenda were the chores. Carlos raised the kitchen: lately, he said, he had washed other people's plates three times, and he wished someone would notice. Ana replied that she had not realised, and asked whether a rota might help. Leo was not convinced. He said rotas sound fine on paper, but nobody follows them, and he did not want to promise anything. Sara let him finish, then asked if he would try it for two weeks. He agreed, although only after she promised that they would review it at the end of the month.
opciones: That she lets people finish and secures a small, short-term promise.
That she pushes the group to a decision quickly, before doubts can be raised.
That she quietly prefers Carlos's view but hides it to seem neutral.
That she gives up on the rota the moment Leo objects.
evaluacion.feedback: Sara deja terminar a Leo, propone una prueba corta y promete revisarla: consigue un compromiso pequeño y revisable sin imponer ni tomar partido.

evaluacion.consigna: Completa: «Tendrán que limar sus diferencias antes de empezar el calendario.»
evaluacion.texto: Carlos and Ana see the chores very differently. Before the rota starts, they will have to ___ out their differences, preferably over a cup of tea.
evaluacion.feedback: Iron out differences es la colocación para resolver con calma desacuerdos concretos.

evaluacion.consigna: Como mediador, escribe lo que dirías en la reunión, de la apertura al acuerdo.
evaluacion.texto: Reunión en tu departamento compartido. Como mediador, escribe unas 210–270 palabras: abre la reunión; expón una queja suave con wish (la cocina desordenada); haz dos preguntas indirectas (I was wondering if…; Could I ask whether…?); reporta lo que preguntó Mia (asked whether…); y propón un acuerdo: turnos de limpieza desde el lunes.
evaluacion.respuesta: Thanks, everyone, for coming. Let me mediate, and I hope we can settle this calmly. First on the agenda: the chores. Lately, the kitchen has been a mess, and I wish we could keep it tidy together. I am sure nobody wants a problem, and I do not want to blame anyone. I was wondering if everyone could wash their dishes on the same day. Could I ask whether a rota would suit you from Monday? Mia asked me whether we could start a cleaning rota, and I think it is a fair idea. Much as we are all busy, what matters is that each person does a fair share. I would like to hear everyone out before we decide. So, shall we agree that we start the rota on Monday, and that we meet again in two weeks to iron out any problems? Are we all happy with that?
aceptadas: Good evening, everybody. Let me mediate this meeting, and let us try to settle the chores today. The kitchen has been a mess lately, and I wish we could share the work. I was wondering if each of us could clean one day a week. Could I ask whether Monday would suit everybody? Mia asked whether we could start a cleaning rota, and I think it is a good idea. I understand that some of you are busy, but what matters is that the work is fair, and I would like to hear everyone out first. Shall we propose a rota from Monday, and meet again in two weeks to see how it goes? Are we all happy to agree on that?

evidencias: i would like to ask whether
i would like to ask if

evaluacion.feedback: Una buena mediación abre con orden, expone la queja con wish, pregunta con tacto, reporta lo que preguntó Mia y cierra con un acuerdo.

repaso.consigna: ¿Qué dan a entender estas actas sobre el resultado de la revisión del calendario?
opciones: That the rota mostly works and needs only a small adjustment.
That the rota has failed, since one flatmate cannot keep to it.
That Leo has used a clash of classes as an excuse to avoid the rota.
That the mediator is pressing everyone to keep the original days.
repaso.texto: Minutes of the flat meeting: the group reviewed the chores rota after two weeks. Most of the flatmates felt that it was workable, although Leo pointed out that Thursday clashes with his classes. Ana asked whether the days could be swapped. The mediator suggested trying Tuesday instead and added that nobody should feel forced to accept a change that they cannot keep.
repaso.feedback: La mayoría lo ve viable y solo choca un día con las clases de Leo: basta un ajuste pequeño, y el mediador propone cambiar a martes.

repaso.consigna: Ordena: «Ojalá pudiéramos mantener la discusión encaminada.»
repaso.respuesta: I wish we could keep the discussion on track
repaso.feedback: Wish + could expresa un deseo sin presionar; keep the discussion on track es la colocación del mediador.

repaso.consigna: Completa: «Preguntó si el grupo podía hallar una solución viable.»
repaso.texto: The mediator asked whether the group could ___ a workable solution by the end of the evening, before everybody went home.
repaso.feedback: Find a workable solution es la colocación habitual; reach o come up with también encajan.

notes: Claves verificadas contra texto/audio en las 5 clases; una sola respuesta defendible por ítem (c27 e0/e1 'no dichos' comprobados como claramente incorrectos).
Distractores reescritos como casi-aciertos en c26 (g0, e1, r0), c27 (p0, r2), c28 r0, c29 (p0, e0, e1, r0, r2) y c30 (p0, p2, e0, e1, r0).
c27 r2: eliminado el distractor «lend if brother agrees» por ser arguible frente a «can't promise»; c29 p2: retirada la respuesta aceptada que no usaba I was wondering if.
aceptadas/rúbricas ampliadas (depended, hinged, take/open up, settle on, variantes de wish/promise/concern).
Español neutro: «piso» sustituido por «departamento» en objetivos de c29/c30; sin vale/deberes/vosotros.
